title: One hand cannot clap
literal_meaning: A clap cannot sound with one hand alone.
explanation: Some things require a response or a shared effort. The image of two palms meeting makes that dependence immediate. It can invite cooperation; it should not be used to assume that both sides bear equal blame for harm.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଇ ହାତ ମିଶିଲେ ତାଳିର ଶବ୍ଦ ହୁଏ—ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ ପରସ୍ପରର ସହଯୋଗର କଥା କୁହାଯାଏ। କିଛି କାମରେ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଚେଷ୍ଟା ସହ ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ବା ସହଭାଗ ଦରକାର। କିନ୍ତୁ କୌଣସି ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଘଟିଲେ ଉଭୟ ପକ୍ଷ ସମାନ ଦୋଷୀ ବୋଲି ଏହି ଉପମାରୁ ଧରିନେବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: One person proposes a shared reading group; the others must also make time for it. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary explicitly labels this example a dhaga under clapping. The explanation here is editorial, not a recorded account of its first use.

odia_summary: କିଛି କାମ ପାଇଁ ଉଭୟ ପକ୍ଷର ସହଯୋଗ ଦରକାର; ଗୋଟିଏ ପକ୍ଷର ଚେଷ୍ଟାରେ ସବୁବେଳେ କାମ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ତେବେ କ୍ଷତି ହେଲେ ଉଭୟ ପକ୍ଷ ସମାନ ଦୋଷୀ ବୋଲି ଧରିନେବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Some actions need shared effort, but that does not mean two parties always bear equal blame for harm.
